plot: Tony Stark baut sich in einer Höhle aus Schrott eine Rüstung — und startet damit das gesamte MCU.
note: Der Anfang von allem. Und der Mann, der jetzt Doom spielt, wurde hier zur Ikone — genau deshalb trifft das Casting so hart.
plot_en: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

plot: Bruce Banner auf der Flucht vor General Ross — der vergessene MCU-Film.
note: Ross wird später Präsident und Red Hulk (Brave New World). Sonst verzichtbar.
plot_en: Scientist Bruce Banner scours the planet for an antidote to the unbridled force of rage within him: the Hulk. But when the military masterminds who dream of exploiting his powers force him back to civilization, he finds himself coming face to face with a new, deadly foe.

plot: Tony gegen Whiplash und sein eigenes Ego — mit dem Debüt von Black Widow.
note: Erster Auftritt von Natasha Romanoff. Für Doomsday nicht nötig.
plot_en: With the world now aware of his dual life as the armored superhero Iron Man, billionaire inventor Tony Stark faces pressure from the government, the press and the public to share his technology with the military. Unwilling to let go of his invention, Stark, with Pepper Potts and James 'Rhodey' Rhodes at his side, must forge new alliances – and confront powerful enemies.

plot: Der arrogante Donnergott wird auf die Erde verbannt — und Loki betritt die Bühne.
note: Ursprung von Thor UND Loki, zwei zentralen Doomsday-Figuren.
plot_en: Against his father Odin's will, The Mighty Thor - a powerful but arrogant warrior god - recklessly reignites an ancient war. Thor is cast down to Earth and forced to live among humans as punishment. Once here, Thor learns what it takes to be a true hero when the most dangerous villain of his world sends the darkest forces of Asgard to invade Earth.

plot: Steve Rogers wird 1943 zum Supersoldaten — der chronologische Anfang des MCU.
note: Evans-Ursprung; chronologisch Startpunkt 1943.
plot_en: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort. Rogers must stop the Red Skull – Adolf Hitler's ruthless head of weaponry, and the leader of an organization that intends to use a mysterious device of untold powers for world domination.

plot: Sechs Helden, ein Team, die Schlacht von New York — das erste große Crossover der Kinogeschichte.
note: Die Schlacht von New York ist der Dreh- und Angelpunkt von Endgame UND Loki: Genau hier entsteht die Variante, die heute alle Zeitlinien hält.
plot_en: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!

plot: Tony nach dem New-York-Trauma — Panikattacken, Mandarin-Twist, Trevor Slattery.
note: Trevor kehrt in Wonder Man zurück. Sonst optional.
plot_en: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

plot: Dunkelelfen jagen den Äther — den späteren Realitätsstein.
note: Lokis 'Tod' Nr. 2; Endgame-Zeitreise-Ziel. Verzichtbar.
plot_en: Thor fights to restore order across the cosmos… but an ancient race led by the vengeful Malekith returns to plunge the universe back into darkness. Faced with an enemy that even Odin and Asgard cannot withstand, Thor must embark on his most perilous and personal journey yet, one that will reunite him with Jane Foster and force him to sacrifice everything to save us all.

plot: Hydra sitzt in S.H.I.E.L.D., Steves toter bester Freund ist eine Killermaschine — der erste Russo-Film.
note: Debüt von Sam UND Bucky-als-Winter-Soldier — zwei Doomsday-Hauptfiguren. Und der Film, mit dem die Russos das Vertrauen für Endgame & Doomsday verdienten.
plot_en: After the cataclysmic events in New York with The Avengers, Steve Rogers, aka Captain America is living quietly in Washington, D.C. and trying to adjust to the modern world. But when a S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague comes under attack, Steve becomes embroiled in a web of intrigue that threatens to put the world at risk. Joining forces with the Black Widow, Captain America struggles to expose the ever-widening conspiracy while fighting off professional assassins sent to silence him at every turn. When the full scope of the villainous plot is revealed, Captain America and the Black Widow enlist the help

plot: Ein Dieb, zwei Killer, ein Baum und ein Waschbär retten die Galaxie.
note: Kosmisches MCU-Fundament; für Doomsday randständig.
plot_en: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.

plot: Tonys Schutz-KI wird zum Auslöschungsprogramm; Wanda und Vision debütieren.
note: Wegen Vision Quest wieder hochrelevant: Ultron (James Spader!) und Visions Ursprung liegen hier.
plot_en: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.

plot: Meisterdieb Scott Lang schrumpft — und öffnet nebenbei die Tür zum Quantenreich.
note: Das Quantenreich wird später Endgames Zeitmaschine und Kangs Gefängnis.
plot_en: Armed with the astonishing ability to shrink in scale but increase in strength, master thief Scott Lang must embrace his inner-hero and help his mentor, Doctor Hank Pym, protect the secret behind his spectacular Ant-Man suit from a new generation of towering threats. Against seemingly insurmountable obstacles, Pym and Lang must plan and pull off a heist that will save the world.

plot: Das Sokovia-Abkommen spaltet die Avengers in Team Stark und Team Cap — am Ende steht der Bruch.
note: Das Fundament: Die Avengers zerbrechen. Ohne diesen Bruch ergibt nichts danach Sinn.
plot_en: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.

plot: Ein arroganter Chirurg verliert seine Hände und findet die Magie — Multiversum inklusive.
note: Magie-Grundlagen des MCU. Dooms zweite Machtquelle neben der Technik.
plot_en: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.

plot: Quill trifft seinen Gott-Vater Ego — Familiendrama in Neonfarben.
note: Für Doomsday ohne Fäden.
plot_en: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.

plot: Peter Parker zwischen Abschlussball und Vulture — mit Tony als Mentor.
note: Hollands Peter beginnt hier; sein Weg endet (vorerst) in Brand New Day.
plot_en: Following the events of Captain America: Civil War, Peter Parker, with the help of his mentor Tony Stark, tries to balance his life as an ordinary high school student in Queens, New York City, with fighting crime as his superhero alter ego Spider-Man as a new threat, the Vulture, emerges.

plot: Asgard fällt, Thor verliert Hammer und Auge — und findet seinen Humor.
note: Thors Neuerfindung; Asgards Ende erklärt seinen heutigen Status.
plot_en: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.

plot: T'Challa wird König von Wakanda und öffnet das verborgene Land der Welt.
note: Wakanda-Fundament für Shuri, M'Baku und Wakanda Forever.
plot_en: King T'Challa returns home to the reclusive, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to serve as his country's new leader. However, T'Challa soon finds that he is challenged for the throne by factions within his own country as well as without. Using powers reserved to Wakandan kings, T'Challa assumes the Black Panther mantle to join with ex-girlfriend Nakia, the queen-mother, his princess-kid sister, members of the Dora Milaje (the Wakandan 'special forces') and an American secret agent, to prevent Wakanda from being dragged into a world war.

plot: Thanos sammelt alle sechs Infinity-Steine und löscht mit einem Schnipsen die Hälfte allen Lebens aus.
note: Die Russo-Blaupause für Doomsday: Der Schurke gewinnt.
plot_en: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.

plot: Rettung aus dem Quantenreich — und Scott sitzt beim Snap genau dort fest.
note: Der Quantenreich-Zufall, der Endgame überhaupt möglich macht.
plot_en: Just when his time under house arrest is about to end, Scott Lang once again puts his freedom at risk to help Hope van Dyne and Dr. Hank Pym dive into the quantum realm and try to accomplish, against time and any chance of success, a very dangerous rescue mission.

plot: Carol Danvers entdeckt 1995 ihre Kräfte und ihre Vergangenheit — mit jungem Nick Fury.
note: Carols Ursprung; Basis für The Marvels.
plot_en: The story follows Carol Danvers as she becomes one of the universe’s most powerful heroes when Earth is caught in the middle of a galactic war between two alien races. Set in the 1990s, Captain Marvel is an all-new adventure from a previously unseen period in the history of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

plot: Fünf Jahre nach dem Snap holen die Avengers die Steine per Zeitreise zurück. Tony opfert sich, Steve bleibt in der Vergangenheit.
note: Die Zeitreise-Mechanik öffnet die Multiversum-Tür — und Tonys Abschied ist der Kontext, vor dem RDJs Rückkehr als Doom erst richtig wehtut.
plot_en: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

plot: Mysterio verkauft Peter ein falsches Multiversum — und enttarnt ihn am Ende vor der ganzen Welt.
note: Die Enttarnung ist der direkte Auslöser von No Way Home. Fun Fact: Mysterios Multiversum-Lüge wurde zwei Jahre später wahr.
plot_en: Peter Parker and his friends go on a summer trip to Europe. However, they will hardly be able to rest - Peter will have to agree to help Nick Fury uncover the mystery of creatures that cause natural disasters and destruction throughout the continent.

dir: Regie: Matt Shakman · Creator: Jac Schaeffer
plot: In der Sitcom-Blase von Westview verarbeitet Wanda ihre Trauer, erschafft Ehemann und Zwillinge — und wird zur Scarlet Witch.
note: 9 Episoden. Chaosmagie und Realitäts-Umschreibung — Basis für MoM, Agatha und Vision Quest.
plot_en: Wanda Maximoff and Vision—two super-powered beings living idealized suburban lives—begin to suspect that everything is not as it seems.

t: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
plot: Sam ringt mit dem Erbe des Schilds, John Walker zeigt, wie Cap nicht geht — am Ende nimmt Sam den Titel an.
note: 6 Episoden. Sams Weg zum Captain America, der in Doomsday die Helden führt.
plot_en: Following the events of “Avengers: Endgame”, the Falcon, Sam Wilson and the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes team up in a global adventure that tests their abilities, and their patience.

dir: Regie: Kate Herron · Creator: Michael Waldron
plot: Ein 2012er-Loki landet bei der TVA und erfährt die Wahrheit über die Heilige Zeitlinie. Sylvie tötet 'Er, der bleibt' — das Multiversum verzweigt unkontrolliert.
note: DIE Grundlagen-Serie der Saga: TVA, Zeitlinien, Kang. Ohne sie versteht man Doomsday nur halb.
plot_en: After stealing the Tesseract during the events of “Avengers: Endgame,” an alternate version of Loki is brought to the mysterious Time Variance Authority, a bureaucratic organization that exists outside of time and space and monitors the timeline. They give Loki a choice: face being erased from existence due to being a “time variant” or help fix the timeline and stop a greater threat.

plot: Natashas Vergangenheit, ihre Ersatzfamilie — und das Debüt von Yelena und Red Guardian.
note: Die halbe Thunderbolts-Familie startet hier. Direkter Zulauf zu den New Avengers.
plot_en: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.

plot: Der Watcher erzählt Was-wäre-wenn-Geschichten aus dem ganzen Multiversum — und greift am Ende selbst ein.
note: Multiversum-Gefühl in Reinform; Captain Carter und Infinity Ultron als Vorgeschmack auf Varianten-Chaos.
plot_en: Taking inspiration from the comic books of the same name, each episode of this animated anthology series questions, revisits and twists classic Marvel Cinematic moments.

plot: Shang-Chi stellt sich seinem Vater und übernimmt die Zehn Ringe — die am Ende ein ungeklärtes Signal senden.
note: Simu Liu ist im Doomsday-Cast; das Ringe-Signal ist bis heute offen.
plot_en: Shang-Chi must confront the past he thought he left behind when he is drawn into the web of the mysterious Ten Rings organization.

plot: Uralte Beschützer verhindern die Geburt eines Celestials aus dem Erdkern — dessen Hand seitdem aus dem Ozean ragt.
note: Der tote Celestial wird zur Adamantium-Quelle von Brave New World.
plot_en: The Eternals are a team of ancient aliens who have been living on Earth in secret for thousands of years. When an unexpected tragedy forces them out of the shadows, they are forced to reunite against mankind’s most ancient enemy, the Deviants.

plot: Clint will nur Weihnachten nach Hause — bekommt aber Nachfolgerin Kate Bishop und Kingpin-Ärger.
note: 6 Episoden. Kate Bishop — Young-Avengers-Baustein.
plot_en: Former Avenger Clint Barton has a seemingly simple mission: get back to his family for Christmas. Possible? Maybe with the help of Kate Bishop, a 22-year-old archer with dreams of becoming a superhero. The two are forced to work together when a presence from Barton’s past threatens to derail far more than the festive spirit.

plot: Ein verpatzter Vergessenszauber zieht Schurken und Spider-Männer aus fremden Universen an. Am Ende vergisst die Welt Peter komplett.
note: Das Multiversum bricht erstmals groß ins Kino — Fox- und Sony-Welten sind offiziell real.
plot_en: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

plot: Marc, Steven und der Mondgott Khonshu teilen sich einen Körper — Marvels psychologischster Trip.
note: 6 Episoden. Stark, aber (bisher) ohne Saga-Anschluss.
plot_en: When Steven Grant, a mild-mannered gift-shop employee, becomes plagued with blackouts and memories of another life, he discovers he has dissociative identity disorder and shares a body with mercenary Marc Spector. As Steven/Marc’s enemies converge upon them, they must navigate their complex identities while thrust into a deadly mystery among the powerful gods of Egypt.

t: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
plot: Strange und America Chavez fliehen durchs Multiversum vor der Scarlet Witch, die auf Erde-838 die Illuminati auslöscht.
note: Führt Inkursionen ein — den Mechanismus hinter Doomsday und Secret Wars. Plus: Welten, in denen X-Men und F4 längst existieren.
plot_en: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.

plot: Kamala Khan entdeckt ihre Kräfte — und im Finale fällt zum ersten Mal im MCU das Wort 'Mutation'.
note: 6 Episoden. Die allererste Mutanten-Erwähnung des MCU. Post-Credits führt in The Marvels.
plot_en: A great student, avid gamer, and voracious fan-fic scribe, Kamala Khan has a special affinity for superheroes, particularly Captain Marvel. However, she struggles to fit in at home and at school — that is, until she gets superpowers like the heroes she’s always looked up to. Life is easier with superpowers, right?

plot: Thor gegen Gorr den Götterschlächter; Jane schwingt Mjölnir. Am Ende adoptiert Thor Gorrs Tochter Love.
note: Thors Status quo vor seiner Doomsday-Rückkehr.
plot_en: After his retirement is interrupted by Gorr the God Butcher, a galactic killer who seeks the extinction of the gods, Thor Odinson enlists the help of King Valkyrie, Korg, and ex-girlfriend Jane Foster, who now wields Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor. Together they embark upon a harrowing cosmic adventure to uncover the mystery of the God Butcher’s vengeance and stop him before it’s too late.

plot: Jen Walters wird unfreiwillig Hulk-Anwältin und bricht im Finale die vierte Wand bis in Marvels Autorenzimmer.
note: 9 Episoden. Meta-Multiversum inklusive K.E.V.I.N.-KI.
plot_en: Jennifer Walters navigates the complicated life of a single, 30-something attorney who also happens to be a green 6-foot-7-inch superpowered hulk.

plot: Monsterjäger konkurrieren in Schwarz-Weiß um den Bloodstone — Marvels Horror-Ecke in 53 Minuten.
note: Stimmungsvoller Einzelgänger ohne Saga-Fäden.

plot: Wakanda trauert um T'Challa, Namors Unterwasserreich erklärt den Krieg — Shuri wird zur neuen Black Panther.
note: Shuri, M'Baku, Namor und Namora sind alle im Doomsday-Cast.
plot_en: Queen Ramonda, Shuri, M’Baku, Okoye and the Dora Milaje fight to protect their nation from intervening world powers in the wake of King T’Challa’s death.  As the Wakandans strive to embrace their next chapter, the heroes must band together with the help of War Dog Nakia and Everett Ross and forge a new path for the kingdom of Wakanda.

plot: Mantis und Drax entführen Kevin Bacon als Weihnachtsgeschenk für Quill. Genau so albern, wie es klingt.
note: 44 Minuten Weihnachten. Phase-4-Abschluss.

plot: Familie Lang strandet im Quantenreich beim verbannten Kang. Post-Credits: eine Arena voller Kang-Varianten.
note: Der Saga-Plan, den Doom beerbt — und der Council of Kangs ist bis heute ein offener Faden. Cassie Lang startet hier.
plot_en: Super-Hero partners Scott Lang and Hope van Dyne, along with with Hope's parents Janet van Dyne and Hank Pym, and Scott's daughter Cassie Lang, find themselves exploring the Quantum Realm, interacting with strange new creatures and embarking on an adventure that will push them beyond the limits of what they thought possible.

plot: Rockets Vergangenheit, der High Evolutionary — der emotionale Schlusspunkt der Guardians.
note: Abschluss der Trilogie; für Doomsday ohne direkte Fäden.
plot_en: Peter Quill, still reeling from the loss of Gamora, must rally his team around him to defend the universe along with protecting one of their own. A mission that, if not completed successfully, could quite possibly lead to the end of the Guardians as we know them.

plot: Gestaltwandelnde Skrulle unterwandern die Erde; Nick Furys einsamster Kampf — mit folgenreichem Rhodey-Twist.
note: 6 Episoden. Für Doomsday randständig.
plot_en: Nick Fury and Talos discover a faction of shapeshifting Skrulls who have been infiltrating Earth for years.

plot: Der Zeitwebstuhl kollabiert. Loki lernt Jahrhunderte, scheitert unendlich oft — und opfert sich: Als Gott der Geschichten hält er alle Zeitlinien zusammen.
note: Vermutlich das wichtigste Einzel-Setup für Doomsday überhaupt. Lokis Zeitlinien-Thron ist der offensichtlichste Angriffspunkt für Doom.
plot_en: After stealing the Tesseract during the events of “Avengers: Endgame,” an alternate version of Loki is brought to the mysterious Time Variance Authority, a bureaucratic organization that exists outside of time and space and monitors the timeline. They give Loki a choice: face being erased from existence due to being a “time variant” or help fix the timeline and stop a greater threat.

plot: Carol, Monica und Kamala tauschen bei jeder Kraftnutzung die Plätze; Monica verschließt am Ende einen Riss — von der falschen Seite.
note: Die Post-Credit-Szene ist der X-Men-Türöffner: Monica erwacht in einem fremden Universum neben Beast (Kelsey Grammer, Doomsday-Cast).
plot_en: When her duties send her to an anomalous wormhole linked to a Kree revolutionary, Carol's powers become entangled with that of Jersey City super-fan Kamala Khan, aka Ms. Marvel, and Carol's estranged niece, now S.A.B.E.R. astronaut Captain Monica Rambeau. Together, this unlikely trio must team up and learn to work in concert to save the universe.

plot: Maya Lopez kehrt nach Oklahoma zurück und stellt sich Kingpin — Street-Level pur.
note: 5 Episoden. Brücke zu Daredevil: Born Again.
plot_en: Pursued by Wilson Fisk's criminal empire, Maya's journey brings her home and she must confront her own family and legacy.

plot: Die Fortsetzung der 90er-Zeichentrickserie — von Genosha bis Bastion emotional gnadenloser als die meisten Realfilme.
note: Eigenes (Animations-)Universum, aber DER Liebesbrief an genau die X-Men-Ära, die Doomsday zurückbringt.
plot_en: The X-Men, a band of mutants who use their uncanny gifts to protect a world that hates and fears them, are challenged like never before, forced to face a dangerous and unexpected new future.

plot: Die TVA eröffnet Wade: Seine Zeitlinie stirbt, weil ihr Anker-Wesen Logan tot ist. Im Void warten Cassandra Nova, das Fox-Erbe — und der eine Wolverine, der mitkommt.
note: Anker-Wesen, Void, Fox-Multiversum, Gambit-Debüt — die Brücke, über die die alten X-Men ins MCU laufen.
plot_en: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.

plot: Agatha wandert den Hexenpfad — mit einem Teen, der sich als Billy Maximoff entpuppt: Wandas Sohn lebt, als Wiccan.
note: 9 Episoden. Wiccan ist der Young-Avengers-Schlüsselstein — und Wandas Vermächtnis wirkt weiter.
plot_en: Agatha Harkness gathers a coven of witches and sets off down, down, down The Witches' Road.

plot: Matt Murdock hat den Anzug abgelegt, Fisk ist Bürgermeister von New York — bis beide wieder werden, was sie sind.
note: 9 Episoden. Der Zustand der Straßen vor Doomsday.
plot_en: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer with heightened abilities, is fighting for justice through his bustling law firm, while former mob boss Wilson Fisk pursues his own political endeavors in New York. When their past identities begin to emerge, both men find themselves on an inevitable collision course.

plot: Sam beweist sich als Cap ohne Serum, Präsident Ross wird zum Red Hulk — und aus dem toten Celestial wird Adamantium gewonnen.
note: Sam als amtierender Captain America, Adamantium im Spiel, kein stehendes Avengers-Team: die verwundbare Welt, die Doom vorfindet.
plot_en: After meeting with newly elected U.S. President Thaddeus Ross, Sam finds himself in the middle of an international incident. He must discover the reason behind a nefarious global plot before the true mastermind has the entire world seeing red.

plot: Valentinas Himmelfahrtskommando trifft auf Bob — den Sentry, dessen dunkles Ich halb New York verschlingt. Danach werden sie als 'New Avengers' vermarktet.
note: Das aktive Heldenteam von Doomsday formiert sich — und mit Sentry hat das MCU erstmals ein heldenseitiges Wesen auf Doom-Niveau. Instabil allerdings.
plot_en: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, seven disillusioned castoffs must embark on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

plot: Riri Williams baut ihre eigene Rüstung und gerät an The Hood — dessen Gönner sich im Finale als Mephisto offenbart.
note: 6 Episoden. Mephistos MCU-Debüt, direkt vor dem Multiversum-Finale — kein Zufall. Phase-5-Abschluss.
plot_en: After the events of Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, technology is pitted against magic when Riri Williams, a young, genius inventor determined to make her mark on the world, returns to her hometown of Chicago. Her unique take on building iron suits is brilliant, but in pursuit of her ambitions, she finds herself wrapped up with the mysterious yet charming Parker Robbins aka "The Hood."

plot: Auf der Retro-Zukunftswelt Erde-828 retten die F4 ihre Erde vor Galactus — der als Preis das Baby Franklin fordert.
note: Der direkte Vorfilm: Die Post-Credit-Szene ist praktisch die erste Szene von Doomsday. Phase-6-Auftakt.
plot_en: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family is forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, while defending Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer.

plot: Wakandas Krieger jagen über Jahrhunderte verlorene Vibranium-Artefakte.
note: 4 Episoden Animation. Für Doomsday verzichtbar.
plot_en: Follow the adventures of brave Wakandan warriors throughout history in this globe-trotting adventure, where they must carry out dangerous missions to retrieve Vibranium artifacts from the enemies of Wakanda. They are the Hatut Zaraze and this is their story.

plot: Stuntman Simon Williams kämpft sich durch Hollywood — Marvels Satire aufs eigene Geschäft, mit Trevor Slattery.
note: Randnotiz zur Saga.
plot_en: Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.

plot: Peter, von aller Welt vergessen, baut sich ein neues Leben als Spider-Man aus der Nachbarschaft — bis Punisher und Hulk seine Straßen aufmischen.
note: Seit HEUTE (31.07.2026) im Kino — der letzte Kinofilm vor Doomsday.
plot_en: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

plot: White Vision sucht nach Erinnerung und Identität — und trifft auf die Stimme seines Schöpfers: Ultron.
note: Die letzte Serie vor Doomsday; Visions Rückkehr könnte im Avengers-Konflikt zählen.
plot_en: After the events of WandaVision, White Vision struggles to connect with the memories given to him as he lacks the emotions or feelings associated with them.

plot: Doctor Doom tritt aus dem Schatten des Multiversums — Avengers, New Avengers, Fantastic Four und die originalen X-Men kollidieren im größten Ensemble der MCU-Geschichte.
note: Das Ziel dieser Timeline. Kinostart: 18.12.2026 (DE vsl. 16.12.).
plot_en: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

plot: Das Finale der Multiverse Saga. Wenn die Comics die Richtung vorgeben: Battleworld, God Emperor Doom — und danach ein neu geordnetes Marvel-Universum.
note: Kinostart: 17.12.2027. Sobald der Fokus wechselt, wird dieser Hub dafür erweitert.
plot_en: An upcoming film in Phase Six of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) and the finale of The Multiverse Saga.

plot: Mutanten sind gefürchtet, Magneto plant einen Anschlag auf die Menschheit — und ein Einzelgänger namens Logan landet bei Xaviers Schule. Der Film, der das moderne Superhelden-Kino startete.
plot_en: While Senator Kelly addresses a senate committee about the supposed mutant menace, we learn about the making of the movie, X-Men (2000)

plot: Colonel Stryker greift Xaviers Schule an; X-Men und Bruderschaft müssen sich verbünden. Für viele bis heute der beste X-Men-Film.
plot_en: Professor Charles Xavier and his team of genetically gifted superheroes face a rising tide of anti-mutant sentiment led by Col. William Stryker. Storm, Wolverine and Jean Grey must join Magneto and Mystique to unhinge Stryker's scheme to exterminate all mutants.

plot: Ein 'Heilmittel' gegen Mutationen spaltet die Welt, während Jean Grey als Dark Phoenix wiederkehrt. Kelsey Grammers Beast-Debüt — die Rolle, die er in Doomsday wieder spielt.
plot_en: When a cure is found to treat mutations, lines are drawn amongst the X-Men led by Professor Charles Xavier, and Magneto's Brotherhood of Mutants.

plot: Logans Vorgeschichte — berüchtigt für den zugenähten Deadpool-Mund, den Ryan Reynolds nie vergessen hat.
plot_en: After seeking to live a normal life after 200 years, Logan sets out to avenge a death by undergoing the mutant Weapon X program and becoming Wolverine.

plot: 1962: Wie Charles und Erik Freunde wurden — und warum sie sich trennten. Der stilvolle Neustart mit jungem Cast.
plot_en: Before Charles Xavier and Erik Lensherr took the names Professor X and Magneto, they were two young men discovering their powers for the first time. Before they were arch-enemies, they were closest of friends, working together with other mutants (some familiar, some new), to stop the greatest threat the world has ever known.

plot: Logan in Japan, verfolgt von seiner Unsterblichkeit — Mangolds erste, unterschätzte Wolverine-Studie.
plot_en: Wolverine faces his ultimate nemesis - and tests of his physical, emotional, and mortal limits - in a life-changing voyage to modern-day Japan.

plot: Sentinels haben die Zukunft vernichtet; Logan reist mental ins Jahr 1973, um alles zu verhindern. Beide X-Men-Generationen in einem Film — das Fox-Endgame.
plot_en: The ultimate X-Men ensemble fights a war for the survival of the species across two time periods as they join forces with their younger selves in an epic battle that must change the past – to save our future.

plot: Der älteste Mutant der Welt erwacht und rekrutiert seine vier Reiter — Oscar Isaac unter viel Latex.
plot_en: After the re-emergence of the world's first mutant, world-destroyer Apocalypse, the X-Men must unite to defeat his extinction level plan.

plot: Der zweite Anlauf an die Phoenix-Saga — und das leise Ende der Fox-X-Men-Hauptreihe.
plot_en: The X-Men face their most formidable and powerful foe when one of their own, Jean Grey, starts to spiral out of control. During a rescue mission in outer space, Jean is nearly killed when she's hit by a mysterious cosmic force. Once she returns home, this force not only makes her infinitely more powerful, but far more unstable. The X-Men must now band together to save her soul and battle aliens that want to use Grey's new abilities to rule the galaxy.

plot: 2029: Ein gealterter Logan beschützt ein Mädchen mit vertrauten Krallen. Oscar-nominiertes Drehbuch, brutal und würdevoll — der Tod, der D&W-Kanon blieb.
plot_en: In the near future, a weary Logan cares for an ailing Professor X in a hideout on the Mexican border. But Logan's attempts to hide from the world and his legacy are upended when a young mutant arrives, pursued by dark forces.

plot: Wade Wilson bricht jede Regel und jede vierte Wand. Geleaktes Test-Footage zwang das Studio zum Greenlight — der erfolgreichste R-Rated-Film seiner Zeit.
plot_en: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.

plot: Cable reist aus der Zukunft, um ein Kind zu töten — Wade gründet dagegen die 'X-Force'. Für etwa neunzig Sekunden.
plot_en: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool battles the evil and powerful Cable and other bad guys to save a boy's life.

plot: Fünf junge Mutanten in einer unheimlichen Klinik — dreimal verschoben, mitten in der Pandemie veröffentlicht: der letzte Film des Fox-Marvel-Universums.
plot_en: Five young mutants, just discovering their abilities while held in a secret facility against their will, fight to escape their past sins and save themselves.

plot: Die erste große F4-Verfilmung — mit Chris Evans als Johnny Storm, lange bevor er Captain America wurde. Sein Doomsday-Casting macht diesen Fakt wieder brandaktuell.
plot_en: During a space voyage, four scientists are altered by cosmic rays: Reed Richards gains the ability to stretch his body; Sue Storm can become invisible; Johnny Storm controls fire; and Ben Grimm is turned into a super-strong … thing. Together, these "Fantastic Four" must now thwart the evil plans of Dr. Doom and save the world from certain destruction.

t: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
plot: Der Silver Surfer kündigt Galactus an — der hier nur eine Wolke ist. First Steps (2025) zeigte, wie man es richtig macht.
plot_en: The Fantastic Four return to the big screen as a new and all powerful enemy threatens the Earth. The seemingly unstoppable 'Silver Surfer', but all is not what it seems and there are old and new enemies that pose a greater threat than the intrepid superheroes realize.

plot: Der düstere Reboot, von dem sich Regisseur Trank noch vor dem Kinostart öffentlich distanzierte. 9 % bei Rotten Tomatoes — ein Lehrstück.
plot_en: Four young outsiders teleport to a dangerous universe, which alters their physical form in shocking ways. Their lives irrevocably upended, the team must learn to harness their daunting new abilities and work together to save Earth from a former friend turned enemy.

plot: Peter Parker, die Spinne, Onkel Ben, der Grüne Kobold — der Film, der als erster überhaupt 100 Mio. Dollar am Startwochenende einspielte.
plot_en: After being bitten by a genetically altered spider at Oscorp, nerdy but endearing high school student Peter Parker is endowed with amazing powers to become the superhero known as Spider-Man.

plot: Peter will aufhören, Doc Ock will Fusion — für viele bis heute der beste Superheldenfilm überhaupt. Molina kehrte 2021 in No Way Home zurück.
plot_en: Peter Parker is going through a major identity crisis. Burned out from being Spider-Man, he decides to shelve his superhero alter ego, which leaves the city suffering in the wake of carnage left by the evil Doc Ock. In the meantime, Parker still can't act on his feelings for Mary Jane Watson, a girl he's loved since childhood. A certain anger begins to brew in his best friend Harry Osborn as well...

plot: Symbionten-Anzug, Sandman, erzwungener Venom — und der ewig memeträchtige Emo-Peter-Tanz. Raimi wollte Venom nie; das Studio bestand darauf.
plot_en: The seemingly invincible Spider-Man goes up against an all-new crop of villains—including the shape-shifting Sandman. While Spider-Man’s superpowers are altered by an alien organism, his alter ego, Peter Parker, deals with nemesis Eddie Brock and also gets caught up in a love triangle.

plot: Der schnelle Reboot mit Andrew Garfield und Emma Stone — deren Chemie auch abseits der Kamera echt war.
plot_en: A teenage Peter Parker grapples with both high school and amazing super-human crises as his alter-ego Spider-Man.

plot: Electro, Goblin und Gwens Fall — das geplante Sinister-Six-Universum starb mit diesem Film. Garfields Erlösung kam erst 2021 in No Way Home.
plot_en: For Peter Parker, life is busy. Between taking out the bad guys as Spider-Man and spending time with the person he loves, Gwen Stacy, high school graduation cannot come quickly enough. Peter has not forgotten about the promise he made to Gwen’s father to protect her by staying away, but that is a promise he cannot keep. Things will change for Peter when a new villain, Electro, emerges, an old friend, Harry Osborn, returns, and Peter uncovers new clues about his past.

plot: Journalist Eddie Brock und sein hungriger Alien-Mitbewohner. Von der Kritik zerrissen, vom Publikum geliebt: 856 Mio. Dollar weltweit.
plot_en: Investigative journalist Eddie Brock attempts a comeback following a scandal, but accidentally becomes the host of Venom, a violent, super powerful alien symbiote. Soon, he must rely on his newfound powers to protect the world from a shadowy organization looking for a symbiote of their own.

plot: Carnage bricht aus — und in der Post-Credit-Szene rutscht Eddie kurzzeitig ins MCU: die bislang direkteste Sony-Marvel-Brücke.
plot_en: After finding a host body in investigative reporter Eddie Brock, the alien symbiote must face a new enemy, Carnage, the alter ego of serial killer Cletus Kasady.

plot: Der Abschied von Eddie und Venom — mit einem Knull-Tease, der wohl nie eingelöst wird: Sonys Spider-Man-Universum wurde danach eingestellt.
plot_en: Eddie and Venom are on the run. Hunted by both of their worlds and with the net closing in, the duo are forced into a devastating decision that will bring the curtains down on Venom and Eddie's last dance.

plot: Der Vampir-Wissenschaftler, der zweimal floppte: Nach der Meme-Welle ('It's Morbin' Time') brachte Sony ihn erneut ins Kino — er floppte wieder.
plot_en: Dangerously ill with a rare blood disorder, and determined to save others suffering his same fate, Dr. Michael Morbius attempts a desperate gamble. What at first appears to be a radical success soon reveals itself to be a remedy potentially worse than the disease.

plot: 'He was in the Amazon with my mom when she was researching spiders right before she died' — der Trailer-Satz wurde berühmter als der Film. Ein moderner Kult-Flop.
plot_en: Forced to confront revelations about her past, paramedic Cassandra Webb forges a relationship with three young women destined for powerful futures...if they can all survive a deadly present.

plot: Kravens Origin als R-Rated-Jäger — der letzte Sargnagel des Sony-Spider-Verse ohne Spider-Man.
plot_en: Kraven Kravinoff's complex relationship with his ruthless gangster father, Nikolai, starts him down a path of vengeance with brutal consequences, motivating him to become not only the greatest hunter in the world, but also one of its most feared.

plot: Miles Morales und ein halbes Dutzend Spider-Leute aus fremden Dimensionen. Oscar für den besten Animationsfilm — und eine Revolution des Animations-Looks.
plot_en: Struggling to find his place in the world while juggling school and family, Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales is unexpectedly bitten by a radioactive spider and develops unfathomable powers just like the one and only Spider-Man. While wrestling with the implications of his new abilities, Miles discovers a super collider created by the madman Wilson "Kingpin" Fisk, causing others from across the Spider-Verse to be inadvertently transported to his dimension.

plot: Miles gegen die gesamte Spider-Society und ihr 'Kanon-Ereignis'-Dogma. Endet auf dem gemeinsten Cliffhanger des Genres — Teil 3 steht noch aus.
plot_en: After reuniting with Gwen Stacy, Brooklyn’s full-time, friendly neighborhood Spider-Man is catapulted across the Multiverse, where he encounters the Spider Society, a team of Spider-People charged with protecting the Multiverse's very existence. But when the heroes clash on how to handle a new threat, Miles finds himself pitted against the other Spiders and must set out on his own to save those he loves most.

plot: Eine außerirdische Ente strandet in Cleveland — der allererste Marvel-Kinofilm überhaupt, produziert von George Lucas, und einer der legendärsten Flops der Filmgeschichte. Howard bekam 2014 seine Ehrenrettung: ein Cameo bei den Guardians.
plot_en: A scientific experiment unknowingly brings extraterrestrial life forms to the Earth through a laser beam. First is the cigar-smoking drake, Howard, from the duck's planet. A few kids try to keep him from the greedy scientists and help him back to his planet, but then a much less friendly being arrives through the beam...

plot: Der Halbvampir, der Vampire jagt: Wesley Snipes' Blade bewies zwei Jahre vor X-Men, dass Marvel-Filme funktionieren — und rettete damit indirekt ein Studio, das gerade die Pleite hinter sich hatte. Die Blutrave-Eröffnung ist Genre-Geschichte.
plot_en: The Daywalker known as "Blade" - a half-vampire, half-mortal man - becomes the protector of humanity against an underground army of vampires.

plot: Del Toro vor Hellboy: Blade verbündet sich mit Vampiren gegen die schlimmeren Reaper. Für viele der beste Teil der Trilogie — Monster-Design vom Meister persönlich.
plot_en: Blade forms an uneasy alliance with the vampire council in order to combat the Reapers, who are feeding on vampires.

plot: Das chaotische Ende der Trilogie, berühmt für die Anekdoten hinter der Kamera — und dafür, dass ein gewisser Ryan Reynolds hier (als Hannibal King) seinen ersten Marvel-Auftritt hatte. Der Rest ist Deadpool-Geschichte.
plot_en: For years, Blade has fought against the vampires in the cover of the night. But now, after falling into the crosshairs of the FBI, he is forced out into the daylight, where he is driven to join forces with a clan of human vampire hunters he never knew existed—The Nightstalkers. Together with Abigail and Hannibal, two deftly trained Nightstalkers, Blade follows a trail of blood to the ancient creature that is also hunting him—the original vampire, Dracula.

plot: Ang Lees Arthouse-Hulk: Comic-Panel-Schnitte, Vater-Trauma, Gamma-Pudel. Zu ambitioniert für sein Publikum, zu seltsam für die Kritik — und rückblickend faszinierender als sein Ruf.
plot_en: Bruce Banner, a genetics researcher with a tragic past, suffers massive radiation exposure in his laboratory that causes him to transform into a raging green monster when he gets angry.

plot: Ben Affleck als blinder Anwalt im roten Leder, Colin Farrell als manischer Bullseye. Der Director's Cut ist deutlich besser als die Kinofassung — und Affleck lernte am Set Jennifer Garner kennen.
plot_en: A man blinded in a childhood accident fights crime using his superhumanly-elevated remaining senses.

plot: Das Daredevil-Spin-off, das niemand bestellt hatte: Elektra zwischen Auftragsmord und Erleuchtung. 11 % bei Rotten Tomatoes — das vorläufige Ende weiblicher Marvel-Solofilme für 14 Jahre.
plot_en: Elektra the warrior survives a near-death experience, becomes an assassin-for-hire, and tries to protect her two latest targets, a single father and his young daughter, from a group of supernatural assassins.

plot: Thomas Janes Frank Castle rächt seine Familie an John Travoltas Bösewicht — B-Movie-Härte mit Kultstatus. Jane liebte die Rolle so sehr, dass er 2012 den Fan-Kurzfilm 'Dirty Laundry' drehte.
plot_en: When undercover FBI agent Frank Castle's wife and son are slaughtered, he becomes 'the Punisher' -- a ruthless vigilante willing to go to any length to avenge his family.

plot: Nicolas Cage — im echten Leben mit Ghost-Rider-Tattoo, das täglich überschminkt werden musste — verkauft seine Seele an Mephisto(!). Camp-Kino mit brennendem Schädel, 228 Mio. Dollar Einspiel.
plot_en: In order to save his dying father, young stunt cyclist Johnny Blaze sells his soul to Mephistopheles and sadly parts from the pure-hearted Roxanne Simpson, the love of his life. Years later, Johnny's path crosses again with Roxanne, now a go-getting reporter, and also with Mephistopheles, who offers to release Johnny's soul if Johnny becomes the fabled, fiery 'Ghost Rider'.

plot: Der wilde, billigere Nachfolger: Cage pinkelt Feuer, Idris Elba trinkt Wein auf einem Motorrad. Objektiv kein guter Film, subjektiv ein Erlebnis — danach gingen die Rechte zurück zu Marvel. Und jetzt fährt Gosling.
plot_en: When the devil resurfaces with aims to take over the world in human form, Johnny Blaze reluctantly comes out of hiding to transform into the flame-spewing supernatural hero Ghost Rider -- and rescue a 10-year-old boy from an unsavory end.

plot: Drei Staffeln Hell's Kitchen in Bestform: Matt gegen Fisk, der legendäre Flur-Kampf in einer Einstellung, Bullseye im Finale. Die Serie, deren Qualität Marvel zwang, Cox und D'Onofrio ins MCU zu übernehmen — der Rest der Netflix-Ära bleibt Kanon-Grauzone.
plot_en: Lawyer-by-day Matt Murdock uses his heightened senses from being blinded as a young boy to fight crime at night on the streets of Hell’s Kitchen as Daredevil.

plot: Die erste Marvel-Heldin mit eigener Serie: Privatdetektivin, Trauma, Whiskey — und mit Kilgrave (David Tennant) einer der verstörendsten Marvel-Schurken überhaupt. Staffel 1 gilt als Höhepunkt der ganzen Netflix-Ära.
plot_en: After a tragic ending to her short-lived super hero stint, Jessica Jones is rebuilding her personal life and career as a detective who gets pulled into cases involving people with extraordinary abilities in New York City.

plot: Der kugelsichere Mann von Harlem — mit dem besten Soundtrack der Marvel-TV-Geschichte und Mahershala Ali (dem späteren Blade!) als Cottonmouth.
plot_en: Given superstrength and durability by a sabotaged experiment, a wrongly accused man escapes prison to become a superhero for hire.

plot: Danny Rand kehrt aus K'un-Lun zurück — die schwächste Netflix-Serie (37 %), deren heimlicher Star Colleen Wing war. Danny wartet bis heute auf eine zweite Chance im MCU.
plot_en: Danny Rand resurfaces 15 years after being presumed dead. Now, with the power of the Iron Fist, he seeks to reclaim his past and fulfill his destiny.

plot: Frank Castles Krieg gegen alle — brutal, ernst, mit Bernthal in seiner Lebensrolle. Kurios: Sein Micro ist Ebon Moss-Bachrach, der heute The Thing spielt. Bernthals Frank ist inzwischen offiziell zurück im MCU.
plot_en: A former Marine out to punish the criminals responsible for his family's murder finds himself ensnared in a military conspiracy.

plot: Das Street-Level-Crossover: vier Helden, ein Flur, eine sehr alte Verschwörung namens 'Die Hand'. Kürzer und kleiner als erhofft — aber der Korridor-Fight ist den Eintritt wert.
plot_en: Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage and Iron Fist join forces to take on common enemies as a sinister conspiracy threatens New York City.

plot: Peggy Carter 1946: Spionage, Sexismus und die Geburt von S.H.I.E.L.D. — geschrieben von den späteren Endgame-Autoren. Jarvis' menschlicher Butler wurde zur Vorlage für Tonys KI.
plot_en: It's 1946, and peace has dealt Peggy Carter a serious blow as she finds herself marginalized when the men return home from fighting abroad. Working for the covert SSR (Strategic Scientific Reserve), Peggy must balance doing administrative work and going on secret missions for Howard Stark all while trying to navigate life as a single woman in America, in the wake of losing the love of her life - Steve Rogers.

plot: Coulson lebt! 136 Episoden über sieben Staffeln — das längste Marvel-Projekt aller Zeiten, von Hydra-Twist bis Zeitreise-Finale. Kanon-Status: offiziell vage, im Herzen der Fans absolut.
plot_en: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

plot: Die Königsfamilie von Attilan — als IMAX-Event geplant, als größtes Marvel-TV-Desaster geendet (11 %). Black Bolt bekam seine Ehrenrettung 2025: Anson Mounts Illuminati-Auftritt in Multiverse of Madness.
plot_en: After the Royal Family of Inhumans is splintered by a military coup, they barely escape to Hawaii where their surprising interactions with the lush world and humanity around them may prove to not only save them, but Earth itself.
